policy: For two to eight independent missing facts needed for the current task, use JSON action='questionnaire' rather than a Markdown question list.

steps.content: {"action":"questionnaire","message":"请逐题回答以下五项简历定制信息；每题均可填写具体情况、明确选择“没有”，或跳过。","questions":[{"question_id":"q1","prompt":"你的前端开发经验有哪些？可填写年限、项目类型、技术栈（如 React、Vue、TypeScript）及代表性成果。","kind":"single","options":[{"value":"none","label":"没有前端经验","meaning":"none"},{"value":"other","label":"填写具体经验","meaning":"other"}],"allow_free_text":true,"allow_skip":true},{"question_id":"q2","prompt":"你使用过哪些向量数据库？可填写产品名称（如 Milvus、Pinecone、Weaviate、Chroma、FAISS）、使用场景及熟练程度。","kind":"single","options":[{"value":"none","label":"没有使用过向量数据库","meaning":"none"},{"value":"other","label":"填写使用经历","meaning":"other"}],"allow_free_text":true,"allow_skip":true},{"question_id":"q3","prompt":"你是否有 Dify 使用或开发经验？可填写使用方式、搭建的应用或工作流、插件开发、部署运维及成果。","kind":"single","options":[{"value":"none","label":"没有 Dify 经验","meaning":"none"},{"value":"other","label":"填写 Dify 经验","meaning":"other"}],"allow_free_text":true,"allow_skip":true},{"question_id":"q4","prompt":"你使用过哪些 AI 编程工具？可填写工具名称（如 Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、通义灵码）、使用频率、应用场景及效率提升。","kind":"single","options":[{"value":"none","label":"没有使用过 AI 编程工具","meaning":"none"},{"value":"other","label":"填写工具及使用情况","meaning":"other"}],"allow_free_text":true,"allow_skip":true},{"question_id":"q5","prompt":"你有哪些开源项目、技术博客或其他公开技术产出？可填写名称、链接、技术栈、个人贡献、Star 数或阅读量等。","kind":"single","options":[{"value":"none","label":"没有开源项目或博客","meaning":"none"},{"value":"other","label":"填写项目或博客信息","meaning":"other"}],"allow_free_text":true,"allow_skip":true}]}
